messages:
Harper: Quick heads-up-- Newton Labs QBR next Tue. Embeds are driving cost. Need a short slide: forecast, a 3-option enablement offer, and alert copy for the renewal owner. Can someone take numbers and a tidy playbook?

Amir: On it. Pulling 7d/30d, embed dim distribution, and token mix. Will post in ~10.

finance-bot: NOTICE: account newton-labs at 64% of monthly retainer. Configured thresholds: 70/85/95.

Dana: Two quick levers we've used: (1) reduce embed dimensionality where safe, (2) enable per-user caching + batching. Both are low-friction and typically cut embed ops cost ~18-30%.

Amir: Numbers paste: ```
7d avg tokens/day: 985,000
30d avg tokens/day: 710,000
Embed ops/day: 21,400 (62% of calls)
Retainer: $11,500/month
Projected 30d spend (status quo): $14,300
Projected 30d spend (with tuning + cache): $11,900
Projected 30d spend (with micro-commit + tuning): $10,400
Days to retainer exhaustion at current pace: 13
``` Link: https://redwood.app/sheets/newton-fidelity-playbook

Leah: I can host a 40-min "fidelity & batching" workshop: 10m audit, 20m hands-on tuning, 10m action list. Deliverable = one-pager + config snippet. Sample snippet for per-user KV cache: ```
kv_cache.enabled = true
kv_cache.max_entries_per_user = 64
kv_cache.ttl_seconds = 3600
```

Harper: Good. For the QBR slide, we need three options to present: A) Complimentary 1hr workshop + playbook; B) Short 2-week micro-commit (20% top-up, 10% discount) + workshop; C) Auto top-up + throttling policy if no commit. Suggest we show cost delta for each.

Dana: Also recommend adding an experiment: drop embed dim from 1024 to 768 on 10% of traffic to measure quality impact before wide rollout. We can promise a rollback plan.

Amir: I'll add a small sensitivity table for embed dims (1024/768/512) and expected cost delta. Also will draft crisp alert copy for 70/85/95. Example 85%: "Newton Labs has used 85% of monthly credits. Recommend scheduling tuning to avoid service interruption."

cs-bot: TASK: Newton Labs QBR prep created. Assigned: Harper, Amir, Leah. Due: 36h.

Leah: Drafting the playbook now. Suggested workshop deliverables: config patch, sample dedup script, perf vs quality checklist. Quick dedup snippet: ```
embed.dedup.enabled = true
embed.dedup.similarity_threshold = 0.9
```

Harper: Owners: Amir -> forecast + sensitivity table; Leah -> workshop + one-pager; Dana -> rollback plan + experiment design; Harper -> QBR slide + renewal ask. I'll assemble deck and circulate by EOD tomorrow.

Amir: Confirmed. Pushing the sheet update and charts now.

Harper: Thanks team let's aim to show the customer a clear path to reduce next-month spend by ~15-30% with low lift. I'll mock the micro-commit language for legal review. :thumbsup:
